title: sports.scores
description: Scoreboard games for a league on a single date (default today). Returns the games array for that date; an off-season or no-games date returns an empty array, not an error. League must be one of the supported ids (see sports.leagues); an unknown league returns MeshDeny: sports_unknown_league. Cached ~15s.

league.description: League id (case-insensitive, normalised to lowercase by the handler). One of the ids returned by sports.leagues, e.g. 'nba', 'nfl', 'epl', 'worldcup'.

date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to query. Defaults to today (UTC) when omitted.
